body:
We need to support single unified API for:

GramJS, teleproto, mtcute, @mtproto/core and so on.

So we take all popular telegram API libraries, and make sure we provide single unified API with extended API for each styles of libraries, but we should merge all the features of these.

So our library will use all these libraries, and yet will provide the best possible solution.

We still can have our code for all missing features in all of top libraries.

See how we did beat all competitors in github.com/link-foundation/command-stream

Now we need to make sure we support features of all telegram libraries in JavaScript ecosystem.

So we fully support the Telegram protocol.

We should also check popular versions of libraries in other languages do make sure we cover everything with tests, and be able to provide the most feature rich telegram API on the planet, and in public domain.

We should use all the best practices, and make everything even better than competitors.

Also all needs of our projects like https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign, https://github.com/konard/telegram-bot, https://github.com/konard/follow, https://github.com/konard/telegram-terminal-bot, https://github.com/konard/telegram-community-posts must be fully addressed.

Also top issues from or competitors as well.

We can provide multiple alternative APIs, yet inside of our library all the features should be deduplicated, and be able to executed via all these libraries, or directly.

So user should be able to choose if he wants any of these libraries to be used, and if all unavailable or decided to be not used, we use our own implementation.

Also it should be able to support all styles of APIs from competitors, yet all of them must be rerouted to these libraries or our code, meaning, it should be easy to migrate from other libraries with minimum code changes from start.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
